items.statement: With a named deputy and a protected monthly slot in each home, rounds will be held in at least 10 of 12 months in all three homes and will review at least 70 percent of residents within six months.
items.rationale: Targets follow the retrieved reach figures (c1) and the conditions for sustainability (c2); need and practice change are high because the operator will decide on continuation.

items.statement: Recommendations made with a family member present are carried out more often than those made without.
items.rationale: Supported elsewhere (c4); worth describing, not testing.

items.statement: Falls will not increase after rounds are introduced.
items.rationale: A balancing proposition, not a claim of benefit (c3).
items.risks: Too few falls for a precise estimate.

summary: h1 selected: adoption, reach and sustainability targets; h2 and h3 descriptive.
